usable_definition:
the five-component `aadistill.evaluation.usable_rollout` on the stored
replies. eval-set-1 registers it for the fluid battery (via score_battery) and
legacy_150; for the stage3_capability units it is the same check applied to the
stored generations, with tools_offered read from the item. No SESOI is
registered for usable, so its contrasts carry intervals and no label.

across_doses.read: the 1x/2x/4x shape, described: each dose's 8 units (7 L40S + the preregistered A100 rank 1)

reference_spread.read: each contrast's paired difference, side by side: seed-to-seed (same candidate, same L40S) is the spread every candidate difference is read against

hardware_note: the Top-1 seed-20260726 unit ran on an A100 and every extension unit runs on an L40S, so a contrast with the A100 unit differs in hardware as well as in seed or candidate and is reported as such, never attributed to one of them
claims: that search rank predicts recovered capability
anything the preregistered H1/H2/H3 did not register
